scope: Development evidence only: an unsigned amd64 1.4 release candidate (live5) for the operator's final hardware checks, built from merged sources with a kernel, loader and world from our own daemonarchy-src build, and the dedicated hwtrace image (dev6, empty queue). Native and Linux tests, runtime audit, bhyve TUI and live (T) boots, a full unattended bhyve install with installed-boot checks, QEMU/OVMF welcome and splash captures, and an hwtrace QEMU loop. Nothing was signed, published, admitted to the release graph or produced under LitAI custody; no desktop rendering, real audio or physical hardware run.
signing: None. No private key was present or used. build-iso.sh ran with only the public 1.3.1 package key (PACKAGE_REPOSITORY_PUBLIC_KEY) and no Secure Boot inputs; the src checkout packages were created without pkg repo signing; pkg-repo-dependencies.sh (fixture signing) was not run.

findings.summary: daemonarchy-rescue prints the no-driver reason, waits up to 15 s, then rescue_menu clears ttyv0; the VNC capture of the installed system shows only the menu. The reason is kept in /var/log/daemonarchy-rescue.log, which menu entry 3 does not show.
Once in three bhyve boots the serial copy of the splash stopped and the loader stalled at the menu without a countdown; QEMU does not copy the splash to serial.
